delivery.outcome: Consume authenticated HTTPS lease renewal in the Koru admission client and supervised module CLI with exact cursor, binding and durable heartbeat receipt validation.
nonGoals: No self-issued policy, new workspace grants or publication authority.
No fleet scheduler or executor renewal loop in this slice.
Preserve foreign Planfile cache and historical work.

architecture.decision: Renew only through the pinned verified HTTPS origin. A cached expired lease is a retry cursor only, never write authority. Require a live policy and current authenticated editing lease, unchanged fence and lease identity, an advanced revision and a bound durable heartbeat receipt. Repair the inherited documented CLI registration expectation and retain handler-routing coverage for all declared commands. Reconcile inherited unmanaged queue staging tests with already adopted primary-local v5 placement and retained interrupted evidence.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material client change and use the preserved previously approved immutable launcher; preserve external policy and lease state.

validation.evidence: Verified TLS transport, exact owner/CAS heartbeat receipts, denied stale/fenced/expired policy, lost-response reconciliation and bounded CLI.

commands: python3 -m pytest tests/test_koru_queue_argv.py tests/test_mcp_server.py tests/test_planfile_queue.py tests/test_queue_cli_helpers.py -q
validation.evidence: Native governance and declared stack gates, protected exact-head independent review and merge.
